exposure: Urticaria medication use during pregnancy (standard-dose second-generation H1-antihistamines, first-generation H1-antihistamines, high-dose second-generation H1-antihistamines, omalizumab)
outcome: Urticaria treatment use patterns during pregnancy
cohort: The study participants were 288 chronic urticaria patients from 13 countries who became pregnant during their disease course.
finding: Most CU patients used treatment during pregnancy, mainly second-generation antihistamines which appeared safe, with preterm birth rates and newborn medical problems similar to population norms and not linked to treatment, though emergency CU referrals increased the risk of preterm birth.
mod_finding: The caesarean delivery rate among CU patients was 51.3%.
